tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, cards and forms on the steel ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, 2px rules, navigation bar, earned facts and done stations. 14.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table headers. 7.9:1 on surface, 7.0:1 on steel.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: 1px row dividers and not-started station segments. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: PSL orange: the current station where a person must act, Start work, the nav underline. White text on it is 5.1:1.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Background of state tags and fact boxes that need a person.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Text on signal-tint, and Reject actions. 7.2:1 on signal-tint.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary buttons (Approve, Ask), links, agent panels' border. White text on it is 6.0:1.

tokens.name: action-tint
tokens.usage: Agent work panels, agent and processing tags, draft cards' header.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Text on action-tint and link hover.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Verified state and on-track notes. 5.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: verified-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Verified tags and confirmation bars.

tokens.name: verified-ink
tokens.usage: Text on verified-tint.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting state words and sample-data labels. 5.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: waiting-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Waiting tags.

tokens.name: waiting-ink
tokens.usage: Text on waiting-tint.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Background of neutral tags: closed, not applicable and information (Cancelled, Out of scope, Not yet, people and role labels, priority). Also count badges.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-tint. 7.5:1.

tokens.name: on-strong
tokens.usage: Text on ink, signal and action fills.

tokens.name: mascot-tola-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind Tola's avatar and her chip.

tokens.name: mascot-chidi-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind Chidi's avatar and his chip.

tokens.name: mascot-zainab
tokens.usage: Zainab, the HR agent: identity only. Never a state colour, never text.

tokens.name: mascot-zainab-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind Zainab's avatar and her chip.
